title: Triton
meta_description: Triton is a chic coastal retreat, just a 3-minute walk to the beach, featuring bright interiors, a private balcony, and easy access to a communal pool and hot tub.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Triton, your gateway to a quintessential Emerald Coast escape. Just a 3-minute stroll from the sugar-white sands and emerald waters, this chic retreat offers the perfect blend of relaxation and coastal adventure. Nestled along the famous Highway 30A, Triton is your serene sanctuary with a dash of excitement.

Step inside to find a bright, airy interior that instantly feels like home. Sunlight pours in through large windows, illuminating the stylish living area, where plush sofas and a flat-screen TV invite you to unwind after a day of sun-soaked fun.

The open-plan design flows seamlessly into a chic dining area with seating for six, perfect for shared meals and laughter-filled evenings. For casual bites, the kitchen counter offers additional barstool seating. The fully equipped kitchen, complete with modern appliances and ample counter space, makes meal prep a breeze, whether you're whipping up a quick breakfast or preparing snacks for a beach day.

The primary bedroom is a haven of comfort with a king-sized bed, a private TV, and an ensuite bathroom for ultimate convenience. The second bedroom is designed for flexibility, featuring a queen bed and a twin-over-twin bunk bed, making it ideal for families or groups.

Outside, your private balcony overlooks the sparkling communal pool and hot tub, where you can cool off or unwind. Enjoy al fresco dining with the gentle ocean breeze as your soundtrack, making every meal a memorable experience.

With easy parking and in-home laundry, Triton is as practical as it is luxurious. The convenience of these amenities allows you to focus on enjoying your vacation, knowing that everything you need is at your fingertips.

Whether you're here for a week or a weekend, this is more than just a place to stay---it's your ticket to an unforgettable beach vacation.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure views, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: St. Andrews State Park, Camp Helen State Park, Ms. Newby's and Runaway Island (karaoke), Jimmy Buffett's Margaritaville, Pier Park, Gulf World Marine Park, Water Planet, Little Village Waterfront Shopping Market, SkyWheel, Shipwreck Island Waterpark.

Home Truths:
- This home allows pets for a fee. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- The communal pool is not heated.

Parking Details:
- Please make sure you park in the designated property parking locations only. If your home offers street parking please make sure you read all posted signage.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
